# FixThePhoto

> > Professional photo retouching and editing services with Photoshop expertise, offering affordable solutions from $0.14/image across 15+ specialized service categories.

FixThePhoto is a comprehensive photo editing service provider specializing in professional retouching across portrait, product, real estate, and wedding photography. The platform offers tiered pricing packages and curated Lightroom preset collections for photographers seeking both outsourced editing and DIY tools.
